body: The Fife van is a fully capable, four season Sprinter designed for extended travel with a refined, residential feel. It combines a large lithium power bank, solar charging, full indoor and outdoor water systems, diesel heat, air conditioning, and smart storage throughout. Clean finishes and durable materials make it comfortable for daily living while remaining ready for remote, off grid miles.

• 400W solar system• 50A DC to DC charger• 800Ah SOK lithium iron phosphate battery bank• 3000W pure sine inverter and charger• Five 110V outlets with USB A and C• GFCI protected outlet system• 30A shore power hookup

• 33 gallon freshwater tank with level sensor and heating pad• Heated greywater system• Indoor FRP shower• Bemiso shower mat• Laveo dry flush toilet with internal battery• Quick connect outdoor shower• Electric water heater

• Premium Havelock wool insulation throughout• Insulated and heated plumbing lines and tanks• Maxxair Deluxe roof vent fan with remote• 12V Nomadic roof air conditioner• Diesel powered Espar cabin heater
• Acacia butcher block countertop with sink insert and flip up extension• Undermount stainless sink• Built in double burner induction cooktop• Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator• 700W microwave
• Stained wood ceiling• Painted shiplap walls• Recessed dimmable LED ceiling lights• Luxury vinyl plank wood style flooring• Tiled backsplash

• Five overhead cabinets• Under counter double door cabinet• Drawer and storage combo cabinet• Floor to ceiling closet with shelves and hanging space• Custom L bench with internal storage• Headliner shelf with magnetic curtain
• Queen memory foam bed• Swivel driver and passenger seats• Lagun adjustable table• Bug nets and blackout window covers• Carbon monoxide and smoke detector• Fire extinguisher

• Passenger sliding door T vent window• Driver side bunk window• No rear door windows with insulated panels• Paint matched body flares• FVCO roof rack with side ladder• Steel Craft side steps• Starlink In Motion High Performance kit
• No suspension upgrade at this time• Rear Mercedes emblem retained per customer request• Papago branding installed elsewhere

• Hearthside Hickory flooring• Cowboy Coffee stain on wood surfaces• Serious Gray cabinetry with soft white walls• Stainless fixtures• White outlets• Leather and stainless hardware• Blue penny tile backsplash with white grout• Sunbrella Metamorphic Lagoon cushions• Paint matched flares
